Module 2: Google Drive: Organize and Share

Upload, organize, find, share, and recover files in Google Drive so the whole office can find the current version of anything in seconds.

5
Lessons
95
Minutes
5
Practice simulations
Beginner
Level

What You'll Learn

  • The parts of Drive: Home, My Drive, Shared drives, Shared with me, Starred, Trash, and Storage
  • How to upload files and folders and check a file's details
  • How to build folders, move and rename files, and use stars, colors, shortcuts, and copies
  • How to search Drive with words, filter chips, and search operators
  • How to share with the right role and general access, set expiration dates, and remove access
  • How Trash and storage work, and how to get a deleted file back

Real-World Scenario

Parkview's Drive grew without a plan: scans sit on the front desk desktop, files for both buildings are loose in My Drive, and nobody is sure who can see what. Denise asks you to fix it. You upload the scans, build a folder system the whole office can follow, find files on request while she is on the phone, share each file with the right people at the right level, and clean up without losing anything the team needs.

Lessons

Complete each lesson in order. Watch the slideshow, read the notes, try the practice simulation, and finish the challenge.

Lesson 1⏱ 20 min
📁

The Drive Screen and Uploading Files

Learn the parts of Google Drive, from New and Home to Shared with me and Trash, and upload files and folders from your computer.

Lesson 2⏱ 20 min
📁

Organizing Files and Folders

Build a folder system your coworkers can follow: create folders, move and rename files, star and color what matters, add shortcuts, and make copies.

Lesson 3⏱ 15 min
📁

Finding Files Fast

Search Drive by name and by the words inside files, narrow results with the Type, People, Modified, and Location filters, and use Recent, Starred, and Shared with me.

Lesson 4⏱ 25 min
📁

Sharing Files and Folders

Share with the right people and the right role, set general access, copy links, add expiration dates, and remove access when it is no longer needed.

Lesson 5⏱ 15 min
📁

Trash, Storage, and Getting Files Back

Delete files safely, restore them from Trash within 30 days, know when a deletion is permanent, and keep an eye on your Google storage.
